using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Net.Http;

using var client = new HttpClient();
using var request = new HttpRequestMessage(new HttpMethod("PUT"), "https://api.test/up");
request.Headers.TryAddWithoutValidation("X-A", "1");
var form = new MultipartFormDataContent();
form.Add(new StringContent("hi"), "note");
form.Add(new StreamContent(File.OpenRead("./a.pdf")), "doc", "a.pdf");
request.Content = form;
using var response = await client.SendAsync(request);
Console.WriteLine((int)response.StatusCode + " " + await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync());
